svg.title: The posterior for p beside the posterior predictive count for ten more batches
svg.desc: Left panel: a single-peaked posterior density for p with its mean at 0.275 and a 95 percent interval beneath. Right panel: paired bars for the number of reworks in ten further batches, the predictive bars visibly wider spread than the plug-in binomial.
svg.text: Two different questions, two different pictures
reworks in the next ten batches
The left panel is what the parameter might be. The right panel is what the next ten batches might do,
averaging the sampling variation over the whole posterior rather than over one plug-in value.
Fixing p at 0.275 and stopping there gives a variance too small by a factor of fifty over forty-one.
